verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of bulk or batch operations. The only related signal is community comments that LangGraph's Pregel/BSP orchestration provides built-in parallelism without data races. That is a plausible basis for fanning work out across many items, but it is indirect and thin. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk APIs (e.g., batch invocation or map-reduce fan-out over item lists), bulk run/thread operations on the Agent Server, and hands-on corroboration of processing many items at once.
